about_pullquote: We answer the phone because we know a burst pipe won't wait until Monday.
about_para_1: Luton Plumbing and Heating Services was founded on the principle that emergency plumbing doesn't have a nine-to-five schedule. For over 18 years, we've been the call families and businesses turn to when something goes wrong with their water or heating. We're Gas Safe Registered, fully insured, and we carry spares on every van so we can fix most problems on the first visit.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on showing up on time, explaining the problem clearly, and fixing it right. We don't believe in surprise bills or unnecessary work — you get a fair quote and an honest assessment every time. That's why so many of our customers call us back, and why they recommend us to their neighbours.
reviews_heading: What Luton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare leak behind the kitchen tiles on a Saturday evening. Called Luton Plumbing at 7pm and Jamie arrived by 8:15. He found the problem, sorted it without tearing the whole wall apart, and explained everything as he went. Really fair price too. Can't ask for more than that.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Our boiler packed in three days before Christmas. I was in a right panic but they got an engineer to us the next morning. New boiler fitted by afternoon and he even helped us bleed the radiators so they'd work properly. Absolute lifesaver.
reviews.author: Helen T.

reviews.text: Been using them for annual servicing on my heating for five years now. Always on time, thorough, and they spot small issues before they become big expensive ones. Good lads, know what they're doing. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Paul R.
